reviews.reason: The cross-page continuation preserves both negatives and their restricted referents. reviews.suggested_text: And likewise a place was made for the souls of people who were not righteous but sinners, complete in transgression, and who will be with the transgressors, like them.[a] But their soul will not be killed on the day of judgment, and those people will not rise from here.[b]
reviews.footnote_changes: Keep a. Revise b to: “Literally, their soul will not be killed uses a feminine-singular construction; the following they will not rise uses a masculine-plural verb referring to these people. Both statements concern this group, not every soul or person. Printed page 60 notes 1–2 report variants in the rising/from-here wording without removing either negation.”
